title: Dinner Lady Lemon Sherbets Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Lemon Sherbets transports you to the sweet shops of yore with its authentic Lemon hard candy flavour, bursting with sweet and zingy citrus with a touch of fizzy sherbet giving the exhale a delightful edge. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
